title: Edit 3D · {title}
errSave: Couldn't save the 3D setup. Try again.
errTooLarge: This 3D setup is too large to save. Remove some variant exceptions or option rules.
noModel: No model yet. Add one to this product first.
noVariants: This product has no variants. Every edit applies to the product.
optionHelp: Set each option value once. Every variant combines the values it has.
exceptionHelp: Only for a variant that differs from its option values, like a special edition.
partsHelp: Click a part here or on the model to edit its material.
canRecolorHelp: Shows a colour picker for this part in the customizer.
canHideHelp: Shoppers can switch this part off.
viewerHelp: How the 3D viewer looks and behaves for shoppers: display, camera, controls, control bar, animation and AR. Saved separately from the scene setup above.
viewerPlacing: Click the model to place the hotspot
hotspotsHelp: Point out details on the model. Add a hotspot, then click the model in Shopper view to pin it.
pricingPlan: Price changes are available on the Advance plan.
pricingHelp: Prices are set per choice under Custom options. This is what a shopper pays for the choices below.
pricingNoOptions: No custom options yet. Add one under Custom options.
pricingNote: Percent prices use the variant price. Conditions aren't part of the cart price table.
replaceHelp: To replace the model, use the product page.
selectPart: Select a part in the list or on the model to change its colour and finish.
useCurrentView: Use current view as start view
startViewSaved: Shoppers start from the view you saved.
startViewAuto: The camera frames the whole model automatically.
galleryHelp: Shoppers can jump to these views. Move the model, then capture.
arHelp: iPhone uses the AR file Shopify generates for the model. Draco-compressed models don't get one.
lowPowerHelp: Renders at a lower resolution to save battery.
importHelp: The JSON for what you're editing now. Paste a configuration and apply it to replace it.
optionsHelp: Let shoppers build their own variant: pick a color, material or parts and see it on the model.
optionsPlan: Custom options are available on the Growth plan and above.
optionsOnDefault: Options apply to every variant, so they are edited on Default.
noGroups: No custom options yet. Add one below to let shoppers customize this product.
choiceVariantHelp: Use a variant name from the model's glTF material variants.
optionsLimit: You can add up to {count} options.
addOptionProductHelp: This product only has its default variant. Name an option (for example Color) and list its values, separated by commas. The current variant takes the first value and a variant is created for each of the others.
optionValuesHelp: Separate values with commas, e.g. Teal, Red, Black
variantImageSet_one: Variant image updated from the 3D model.
variantImageSet_other: {count} variant images updated from the 3D model.
errVariantImage: Couldn't set the variant image. Try again.
errVariantImageView: Switch to the 3D editor view to take the picture.
copy3dHelp: Choose which variants get {name}'s 3D setup. Their own setups are replaced.
reset3dBody: This variant's own model, colours and options are removed, and it shows the product's default 3D setup instead.
variant3dSaved: Saved as a draft. Publish it from the 3D editor to make it live.
errVariant3d: Couldn't update the 3D setup. Try again.
addVariantHelp: Enter a value for each option. A new value is added to the option automatically.
variantPriceHelp: Leave empty to use the product's default price.
deleteVariantBody: “{name}” will be deleted from your product in Shopify, along with its 3D setup. This can't be undone.
errVariant: Couldn't update the variant. Check the values and try again.
errLastVariant: A product needs at least one variant.
layerModelHelp: Its parts and materials are set up separately from the default model.
condNothing: Add a product option or another custom option first.
addOptionMoreHelp: Name another option (for example Size or Material) and list its values, separated by commas. A variant is created for every combination with the existing options.
optionsInherited: This one uses Default's customer options ({count}). Customize to give it its own.
optionsOwn: This one has its own customer options. Changes here don't affect Default or other variants.
addValuesHelp: Separate values with commas, e.g. XL, XXL. Variants are created for the new combinations.
removeValueBody: Variants that use {value} in {name} will be deleted from the product. This can't be undone.
removeOptionBody: The {name} option and the variants built on it will be removed from the product. This can't be undone.
setPricesHelp: Choose a value for one or two options to price only those variants, or leave everything on Any to price all of them. Apply several times for different prices.
compareAtKeep: Optional. Leave empty to keep the current compare-at prices.
stockKeep: Optional. Leave empty to keep the current quantities.
savedDraft: Draft saved · not live yet. Use Preview to see it, then Publish.
setQuantitiesHelp: Choose a value for one or two options to set stock for only those variants, or leave everything on Any to set all of them. Prices are not changed.
editVariantHelp: Changes here apply to this variant only. Each section saves on its own.
optionsThisVariantOnly: Only this variant changes. Other variants keep their values; a new value is added to the option.
